Deepen pass 2026-10-07 (second movement, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). DEPTH — movement-31 stands in 3d (view mode 3d, yaw 0.3 / pitch 0.18, field depth 0.55 authored as the volume of the unmastered middle). There the third dimension IS the seam: the psychic pattern's twin rings stand in front of the field's plane (z +0.3, nearer the viewer), the physical pattern's twin rings stand behind it (z −0.3), and the red seam holds the middle plane (z 0) — the same pattern on both sides of one threshold, which is the record's own plate (psychoid-field-one-seam) read as depth rather than diagram. The psyche→physis walker crosses the seam literally: its two steps move front-to-back through the middle plane, so 'two descriptions retained across one seam' is performed as travel through z. ALIVE — one morph scene on m31: engine.morphEnabled with trajectory toroidalHopf and sine drive; morph law theta at thetaRate 0.14 / phiRate 0.1 — the two rates are the same pattern carried on the two sides of the seam, one field circulating across its own unmastered middle while the drawn plate holds. Four physics profiles across the journey (particle props vary across states, hold within rests): seam dusk (m31: grain 0.04, halo 0.16, opacity 0.9, roundness 0.88, softness 0.2, irregularity 0.42, elongation 0.05, contrast 0.91, depth 0.55); indigo holding (m32–m33 shared: grain 0.05, halo 0.2, opacity 0.86, roundness 0.82, softness 0.28, irregularity 0.5, elongation 0.06, contrast 0.88 — a quieter bloom for mutual legibility); ember (m34–m35 shared: grain 0.03, halo 0.1, opacity 0.93, roundness 0.92, softness 0.14, irregularity 0.3, elongation 0.1, contrast 0.95 — fine and sharp in the recognition heat); spectrum gather (m36: grain 0.045, halo 0.24, opacity 0.84, roundness 0.76, softness 0.24, irregularity 0.55, elongation 0.12, contrast 0.86, depth 0.3 — the widest halo for the gathered spectrum). The crossed-zero chain's 'warming to red' now lives in the drawn ring beneath the walk: the field the first mark institutes carries eight same-text steps at the walker's own cadence, tint warming parchment→red and tintWeight 0.3→0.9 as recognition returns — colour kept, step-scale kept (the text-changing steps themselves carry no objectState; the engine auto-fits each glyph, positions still animate). m36's five declared lenses each carry their own refraction tint (blue, green, amber, red, violet) — the spectrum stands in the fan, not in the walker's glyph. TITLES — every scene title is the record's own line: m31 'Two descriptions retained across one seam' (the QL anchor), m32 'Determining capacity and indefinite particular in one relation' (the claim), m33 'The complexio oppositorum preserves the energy of opposites' (the claim's first clause), m34 'The stroke that first hides zero becomes the bar' (the record's image), m35 'Apollonian form becomes transparent to Dionysian participation' (the claim), m36 'Each account a declared refraction' (the claim). STEP-SCALE — all 20 text-changing steps drop objectState entirely (the craft pass had stripped size but left partial states, which the schema refuses); same-text steps of non-text formations keep complete objectStates (the capacity ring's breathing, the instance disc's brightening, the Apollo/Dionysus interleave, the warming field ring). Rest pairs unchanged: m32–m33 and m34–m35 hold identical settings within each shared profile.
